name: The Princess of Zunuria
source:
Hundreds of years in the future, in a galaxy we have not discovered yet, most humans have settled on a planet known as Zunuria, because it most resembles Earth. After some initial wars in making claims over territories, society has rebuilt itself from the ashes into a more peaceful place, where humans, aliens, and creatures of many kinds coexist and live in harmony. However, a new evil has begun to rise in the form of an Empire known as the Serpen.

We begin this adventure with a group who once worked for the Serpen, but on a fateful day they are able to escape and land on a mysterious planet where they will embark on a new adventure. This planet is known as the world of Zunuria, a land full of dangers, beauty, friends, foes and surprises at every turn.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/serpensoldier]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
数百年后的未来，在一个尚未被我们发现的星系中，大多数人类定居于名为祖努里亚的星球，因为它与地球最为相似。最初，人们为争夺领土而爆发战争；如今，社会从废墟中重建，变成了一个更加和平的地方，人类、外星人与各种生物共存，和谐生活。然而，一股名为“塞尔彭”的帝国势力开始以新的邪恶形态崛起。

冒险从一群曾为塞尔彭工作的人开始。命运注定的那天，他们成功逃脱，降落到一颗神秘星球，并在那里展开新的冒险。这颗星球就是祖努里亚世界：一个处处充满危险、美景、朋友、敌人与惊喜的土地。

[据[url=https://www.patreon.com/serpensoldier]Patreon[/url]编辑]
